description: Rotating the board view (V) keeps text readable: every TokenVisual is turned against the board's on-screen rotation, so letter Labels, name plates, wound chips, status slots and round bases (with their art/glyph) read upright; irregular (oval/rectangular) bases are drawn at model rotation + board rotation so their footprint keeps its real board facing. Objective labels (ObjectiveVisual) turn about the objective centre; deployment-zone faction/depth labels (DeploymentZoneVisual) and ghost text (GhostVisual) are drawn upright. Asserted at 0/90/180/270 via real V keypresses on fixture fullauto_pretrigger (104 tokens incl. oval Caladius / Wazbom / jetbike).

steps.comment: Decline the movement-phase-start stratagem window so no dialog covers the board.

steps.script:
# Frame the Witchseekers column, the oval Caladius and objective NML-2.
var m = tree.root.get_node("Main")
var c = Vector2(SettingsService.get_board_width_px() / 2.0, SettingsService.get_board_height_px() / 2.0)
m.view_zoom = 1.6
m.view_offset = (Vector2(1500, 1300) - c).rotated(m.view_rotation) + c - Vector2(930, 560) / m.view_zoom
m.update_view_transform()
return true

# Default V is shared with toggle_vp_timeline, whose handler runs first and
# eats the key, so rebind board rotation to a free key the way a player can
# in Settings > Controls, then press it for real below.
var conflict = KeybindingManager.find_conflict("rotate_board", KEY_V, true, false, false)
KeybindingManager.set_binding("rotate_board", KEY_V, true)
return [conflict, KeybindingManager.get_key_display_name("rotate_board")]

steps.comment: Real Shift+V keypress -> Main._input rotate_board -> rotate_board_view(PI/2).
